quests.desc: Your objective is to retrieve the napkin from the freezer within the scullery.

Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First of all, you could, like, retrieve the napkin from the freezer inside the scullery. After that, head east. Once you do that, ensure that the gate is open. And then, make an effort to go to the south. Next, put the napkin on the bookshelf. Alright, thanks!

infos.name: office
infos.desc:
Look at you, bigshot, walking into an office like it isn't some huge deal.

 You scan the room for a bookshelf, and you find a bookshelf. [if there is something on the s_0]On the bookshelf you see [a list of things on the s_0].[end if][if there is nothing on the s_0]But the thing is empty. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it?[end if]

 There is [if d_0 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] gate leading north. There is an unblocked exit to the east. There is an unguarded exit to the west.

infos.name: cubicle
infos.desc:
You've just walked into a cubicle.

 You see an armchair. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? The armchair is usual.[if there is something on the s_1] On the armchair you can see [a list of things on the s_1].[end if][if there is nothing on the s_1] But the thing is empty, unfortunately.[end if]

You need an unguarded exit? You should try going east.

infos.name: basement
infos.desc:
Well, here we are in a basement. You begin looking for stuff.



There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unblocked. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unguarded.

infos.name: spare room
infos.desc:
A decrepit notice tells you that you are now in the spare room.

 You can make out a workbench. The workbench is normal.[if there is something on the s_2] On the workbench you make out [a list of things on the s_2]. Hmmm... what else, what else?[end if][if there is nothing on the s_2] But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of trash.[end if]

You need an unblocked exit? You should try going north. There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unblocked. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unguarded.

infos.name: cellar
infos.desc:
You are in a cellar. A typical kind of place. The room is well lit.



 There is [if d_0 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] gate leading south. There is an exit to the east. Don't worry, it is unblocked. There is an unblocked exit to the north. There is an unguarded exit to the west.

infos.name: scullery
infos.desc:
You are in a scullery. An usual kind of place.

 You see a freezer. Is this what you came to TextWorld for? This... freezer?[if c_0 is open and there is something in the c_0] The freezer contains [a list of things in the c_0].[end if][if c_0 is open and the c_0 contains nothing] Empty! What kind of nightmare TextWorld is this?[end if]

There is an exit to the east. Don't worry, it is unblocked.

infos.name: kitchen
infos.desc:
You find yourself in a kitchen.



You don't like doors? Why not try going south, that entranceway is unguarded. There is an unguarded exit to the west.

infos.name: studio

You've entered a studio.



There is an unblocked exit to the east. There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unblocked.

objective: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First, it would be a great idea if you could take the napkin from the freezer. Then, travel east. And then, ensure that the gate is open. Then, make an effort to take a trip south. And then, place the napkin on the bookshelf. That's it!
